caption: The drawing depicts a detailed schematic of a block front desk with a segment top. The primary object is a large cabinet-style desk with a decorative segmented top, finials, and a central arched pediment. The front view (left) displays two doors on either side that open to reveal interior compartments colored in pastel shades of blue, pink, and green. Below these compartments, there are three central drawers colored in light pink and flanked by additional storage colored in green, pink, and blue. Directly below, there is a writing surface with several drawers, and beneath that, three rows of larger drawers, each fitted with ornate gold-colored handles. The side view (middle) shows the depth and profile of the desk, which features bracket feet. In the upper right, there are detailed component drawings including sectional views of the colorful compartments, the shape of bracket feet, a detail of the arched door, and patterns for the brass hardware, shown in gold color. Annotations provide scale information, labeling, and construction notes in black text. The background of the drawing is a tan or light beige color, and all line work is rendered in fine black ink.
title: Block Front Desk with Cabinet Top
